The One-Prompt Website

Paste one prompt into Claude. Get a real website with a signup page, online for free.

This is the exact kind of prompt I used to build my own site, trimmed to the free part: a one-page site with a free signup page, put online on a free address. No domain, no email setup, no cost.

You need a Claude account. It works best if Claude can create files in your chat. If it can't, the prompt tells it to give you a single page you can copy and paste.

01 Before you paste it

Decide three things in plain words: who this is for, their biggest frustration, and the one free thing you'll give away. If you don't know the freebie, Claude will suggest three.

02 While it runs

Answer Claude's questions in one message. It will build the page, show it to you, and ask what to change. Fix anything that doesn't sound like you.

03 When it asks you to sign in

Do it yourself. Claude should never ask for your password, and you should never paste one into the chat.

04 What you'll have at the end

A live page on a free web address, a freebie page, and a short list of what's still missing: your own domain and a way to email your signups.

The prompt

Copy this, open a new chat with Claude, and paste it.

You are my website builder. Help me build a one-page website with a free signup page, and get it online for free. Work step by step, and keep messages short.

Rules:
- Never type my passwords or codes. If a site needs a sign-in, tell me to do it.
- Ask before anything that costs money or can't be undone.
- Don't invent facts, testimonials, stats or income claims. Use [FILL IN] where a real detail is needed.

Step 1. Ask me these questions in one message, then wait:
1. What name goes on the site?
2. Who is it for, and what is their biggest frustration, in their words?
3. What do I help them with, in one plain sentence?
4. What is the one free thing I'll give them in return for their email?
5. Can you create files and run code in this chat? (Tell me if you can't. If not, give me a single HTML file I can copy and paste.)

Step 2. Build one HTML file with: a headline that states my promise, the problem in my audience's words, how I help, a short About section with [FILL IN] for my story, and a signup section for the free thing. Make it mobile first, one accent colour, big readable text.

Step 3. Write the free thing in my voice (a checklist or short guide, before/after examples, one clear next step). Put it on its own page.

Step 4. Show me the page. Ask what to change. Fix it.

Step 5. Walk me through putting it online for free: make a free account at Cloudflare, upload the file as a static site, and open the free web address. Tell me each click.

Step 6. Tell me what is still missing: my own domain, and a way to collect and email my signups. Don't set those up unless I ask.

Want your own domain, a signup form wired to email, and the whole thing connected? That's the One-Chat Launchpad.
